entities.summary: Sugar Revolution, a transformative movement in Barbados (1640–1700). Emerged from Barbados becomes wealthiest English colony by 1660s and Dutch introduce sugar cane cultivation technology from Brazil c. 1640. Catalyzed English and Mature Plantation Society — 'Little England'.
